mapper.delete: DELETE FROM updated_auth.users WHERE id = #{id}; DELETE FROM updated_auth.user_roles WHERE user_id = #{id};
mapper.select: SELECT u.id as user_id, u.login as user_login, u.password as user_password, u.name as user_name, u.birthdate as user_birthdate, u.age as user_age, u.salary as user_salary, r.name as user_role FROM updated_auth.users u LEFT JOIN updated_auth.user_roles ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN updated_auth.roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.login as user_login, u.password as user_password, u.name as user_name, u.birthdate as user_birthdate, u.age as user_age, u.salary as user_salary, r.name as user_role FROM updated_auth.user_roles ur FULL JOIN updated_auth.users u ON u.id = ur.user_id FULL JOIN updated_auth.roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.login as user_login, u.password as user_password, u.name as user_name, u.birthdate as user_birthdate, u.age as user_age, u.salary as user_salary, r.name as user_role FROM updated_auth.user_roles ur FULL JOIN updated_auth.users u ON u.id = ur.user_id FULL JOIN updated_auth.roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.login = #{login} and u.password = #{password}
